summary: Switched the repo to a no-admin WSL/Linux setup: fixed PATH handling for Linux shells, documented the Linux Zed requirement, pinned Node 20 with .nvmrc, and verified the wasm build passes in WSL.
timeline: Confirmed the Windows host was still using the Windows Zed binary and lacked the linker path.
Validated that WSL had cargo/rustup but no native Linux Node.
Installed Node 20 in WSL via nvm without admin rights.
Updated scripts to use platform-correct PATH separators.
Rewrote the README to document the WSL/Linux no-admin path and Linux Zed requirement.
Verified npm run build:wasm succeeds in WSL with the native Linux Node toolchain.
Verified npm run doctor now fails only because WSL resolves zed to the Windows install path.
commands: wsl.exe bash -lc 'export NVM_DIR=/home/erisanh/.nvm; . /home/erisanh/.nvm/nvm.sh; nvm install 20; nvm alias default 20; node --version; npm --version'
wsl.exe bash -lc 'export NVM_DIR=/home/erisanh/.nvm; . /home/erisanh/.nvm/nvm.sh; cd /home/erisanh/projects/area/zed-database-client && npm run doctor'
wsl.exe bash -lc 'export NVM_DIR=/home/erisanh/.nvm; . /home/erisanh/.nvm/nvm.sh; cd /home/erisanh/projects/area/zed-database-client && npm run build:wasm'
decisions: Treat the no-admin path as Linux-native WSL, not Windows Zed plus WSL workspace.
Keep the repo build scripts usable in WSL by switching to path.delimiter for PATH handling.
Pin Node 20 in .nvmrc so the WSL setup is reproducible without admin rights.
issues: WSL still resolves zed to the Windows installation at /mnt/c/Users/RkUser/AppData/Local/Programs/Zed/bin/zed.
The no-admin build path requires a Linux Zed binary inside WSL; the Windows Zed binary will still build on Windows and require MSVC tooling.
The native Linux Node toolchain now exists in WSL, but Zed itself has not yet been switched to a Linux install.
next_steps: Install or launch the Linux Zed binary inside WSL, then retry Install Dev Extension.
If needed, add a tiny helper note in the repo for launching the Linux Zed binary from WSL.
Re-run npm run doctor after zed resolves to a Linux binary to confirm the full no-admin path.
Re-run the dev-extension install from the Linux Zed app.
